import bpy,contextlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
ec=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Export']
for o in ec.objects:
 if not any(m.type=='TRIANGULATE' for m in o.modifiers):
  m=o.modifiers.new('Export triangulation preserving authored normals','TRIANGULATE')
  if hasattr(m,'keep_custom_normals'):m.keep_custom_normals=True
  m.quad_method='FIXED';m.ngon_method='BEAUTY'
with (root/'captures/surface_pass_20261113/yard_export.log').open('w',encoding='utf8') as log:
 with contextlib.redirect_stdout(log),contextlib.redirect_stderr(log):
  import json
  payload=json.loads((root/'source/surface_pass_10_export_yard.mcp.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
  exec(payload['code'])
print('SP13_YARD_TRIANGULATED_EXPORTED')
